I have zero irritation (which was a problem I had with others), and after a few weeks of use it is starting to look like I'm wearing mascara when my lashes are bare. I also started using it in a spare patch of my brows and am noticing hair growth!

claims.text: Reviewers widely report that the serum makes their eyelashes longer, often noticing results within weeks.
Many users say the product is gentle and causes little to no irritation, stinging, or itching, unlike other serums they have tried.
Several reviewers praise the value, noting it works as well as or better than pricier prescription and name-brand alternatives.
Users find the applicator brush easy to use, comparing it to a liquid eyeliner.
Some reviewers note their lashes got longer but not noticeably thicker.
